turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have until 4:40, and I want to know who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay before anyone picked up a phone to me. Start there.
You asked for this meeting, and I'd have asked for it anyway. Who decided on the zero, Hale?
The file was created at 11:31 PM. 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM and 794 more at 11:58 PM.
I'm writing down those times. Which file is that, what date, and where does it come from? Show me the page.
How long after the file was created did the first words appear?
You're asking me to do your arithmetic from times with no date on them. If you have the document, put it in front of me and I'll read it myself.
What time is it now, by the way?
About 4:20. I have until 4:40, and I still don't have a document.
